significance: A Buddhist stupa and monastery near Samangan hewn entirely out of the bedrock in the 3rd-4th centuries CE under the Kushano-Sasanians. After the Muslim conquests the abandoned complex was absorbed into Persian legend, which supplied its present name.
story: Persian tradition holds that the hero Rostam of Ferdowsi's Shahnameh travelled to the kingdom of Samangan and stayed with its king at this place.
